base: Frozen fold-matched PromptTimeDART; no neural base or memory refit
adapter_fit: memory plus calibration_early, source turbines1-5 only; memory-period queries have zero retrieval inputs because the complete bank was not yet available
adapter_selection: first chronological half of calibration_late, donors only
benefit_calibration: second chronological half of calibration_late, donors only; disjoint target intervals
selection: lowest average MAE/RMSE ratio among epochs jointly no worse than epoch0; epoch0 fallback; no outer selection
utility_rule: Fresh actual frozen WikiContext minus NumericContext errors in later training calibration; positive MAE/MSE and >=2/3 positive donor units; finest supported cell vetoes fallback
evaluation: One declared development outer evaluation per fold after all expert parameters and certificate are frozen; existing validation is not independent confirmation
known_limitation: Different numeric adapters can improve due to additional train labels; Wiki contribution must be paired against NumericContext, not just original base
